mindsdb-mcp-skill v1.0.0

- Initial release of MindsDB MCP server interaction skill.
- Enables natural language querying and management of 200+ enterprise data sources via MindsDB MCP.
- Supports database connections (SQL/NoSQL/SaaS/file), AI model creation, knowledge base (RAG) building, intelligent Q&A, and advanced data analysis.
- Provides an agent-driven workflow for database ops, automation, and predictive analytics using everyday language—no SQL required.
- Includes detailed documentation, best practices, troubleshooting, and use-case examples for non-technical and advanced users.
